Cold docker build of the task image at 1 CPU: ~17 s (clone + pip install of the pinned test toolchain; pip itself is pure Python; cached layer reuse makes repeat builds near-instant). Reproduces in <1 s in the built image: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from pip._internal.models.link import Link; print(Link("https://example.com/a%252Fb.whl").filename)' -> 'a/b.whl' at parent, 'a%2Fb.whl' after applying the 3-file upstream fix (link.py / download.py / prepare.py). Golden file (fix-commit tests/unit/test_link.py) FAILS collection at parent (ImportError: as_path_component missing) and passes 72/72 after the fix; the in-repo parent unit slice tests/unit/test_link.py + tests/unit/test_operations_prepare.py passes 54/54 both before and after the fix (nothing else broke). Instruction ships NO reproduction: the agent must write /app/reproduce.py (its own failing repro, contractual single FILENAME: line, exit 0 iff single path component) and the verifier runs it against both the repaired tree and a pristine git-archive copy of the parent commit.
notes: Upstream-clone real-issue debugging task (v4.3 family): pypa/pip at the parent of the fix for issue #14110, where Link.filename percent-decodes the already-decoded URL path a second time, so a doubly-encoded separator %252F collapses into a real '/' (a%2Fb.whl -> a/b.whl) and the derived file name drifts from the one the URL names. The checkout is cloned shallow at the parent (fix commit never in the object store; golden extraction in a throwaway clone that is deleted). The instruction describes the user-visible symptom only — it names neither the issue, the commit, the source file nor the fix — and deliberately omits any reproduction: the agent must first write /app/reproduce.py, a failing reproduction deliverable with a precise contract, then find and fix the double-decode so that script flips from fail to pass. The verifier (0) pins interpreter+site-packages and the /app/src deliverable tree to build-time manifests (allowing exactly the three fix files src/pip/_internal/models/link.py, src/pip/_internal/network/download.py, src/pip/_internal/operations/prepare.py to differ; .git/info/exclude hashed) plus a SHA-256 pin of /opt/golden (all under /tests so harbor re-uploads them un-forgeable); (1) asserts provenance: HEAD still the parent commit, the only work-tree changes a non-empty subset of the three allowed files including link.py, no untracked files, and the fix commit unreachable via git cat-file; (2) runs the AGENT'S OWN reproduction against the repaired tree (must pass) and against a pristine copy of the parent commit materialised with git archive (must fail and print the collapsed '/'-containing name), closing wrapper/logic gaps; (3) runs the project's own regression test extracted from the fix commit (/opt/golden/test_link.py, 72 tests); (4) runs the parent's own in-repo unit slice (tests/unit/test_link.py + tests/unit/test_operations_prepare.py, 54 tests) to prove nothing else broke; (5) runs two authored hidden cases with inputs the upstream test does not use (double-encoded '+', space, '#', '%' bytes; traversal-shaped paths a/%2e%2e/; on-disk single-component join semantics). Reward is binary with the standard trap.
